access: ■Shirokanedai Station (13 minutes on foot) Exit from Exit 1 and head left, cross the Shirokanedai intersection (the intersection with Platinum Donki), and proceed down the Gaien Nishi (Platinum) Street. Turn left at the second traffic light. This is the street where the Matsuoka Museum of Art is located. Continue down until you reach the left side just before hitting Line 2, next to the park on the right. *Please note that the nearest station is Shirokanedai Station, not Shirokanekawara Station. Be careful as the names are very similar. ■JR Ebisu Station (17 minutes on foot) From the East Exit, proceed along the Skywalk towards Garden Place. After passing through the Skywalk, do not go above ground; instead, take the escalator on your right down and proceed through the underground passage. After passing the underground entrance to the Westin, continue straight through the underground passage until you reach the surface. Once outside, go down the slope and continue straight along the road until you reach a wide road (Line 2) with an expressway above. Our restaurant will be on your right after crossing the pedestrian crossing. ■JR Meguro Station (16 minutes on foot) It may be difficult to find as you will be passing through a residential area, so please be careful. From Meguro Station, take the bus 【Kuro 77 to Sendagaya】 or 【Hashi 86 to Akabanebashi/Tokyo Tower】 to "Shirokane Rokuchome" for 5 minutes, then it’s a 4-minute walk from the bus stop. The bus stop is number 2 in the rotary at the East Exit of JR Meguro Station. ■Taxi (5 minutes from each station) It costs about one meter from Hiroo, Ebisu, Meguro, and Shirokanedai. *There are many Barbizon buildings, so please provide the address. It is Shirokane "Dai" 5-chome, not Shirokane 5-chome. ■From the Westin Hotel (5 minutes on foot) With your back to the main entrance of the Westin Hotel, go down the slope on your right. When you reach the road, turn left and proceed. (Alternatively, exit from the B1 level of the Westin Hotel that leads to the Ebisu Promenade, go straight to the left, and you will exit outside. Continue down the slope and proceed straight.) After walking for 2-3 minutes, you will reach Line 2, which has an expressway above. Our restaurant will be diagonally to your right after crossing the pedestrian crossing. ■By Car Please search for "Shirokanedai Kobayashi" on the s-park website. You can also check for available parking. 718 meters from Shirokanedai.
